caption: The drawing depicts a single sculptural object resembling an elephant standing upright on a round pedestal base. The elephant is shown in profile, facing left, with its trunk curled upward toward its mouth. The body of the elephant is decorated with a harness or ornamental covering featuring geometric and linear patterns. The colors used in the drawing are primarily muted earth tones such as grays, browns, and ochres, giving the object a stone or metal-like appearance with areas of shading suggesting a three-dimensional form. The pedestal base is cylindrical with simple molding and is rendered in similar brownish and grayish tones. The background is an unadorned, off-white or cream-colored surface, and the drawing is signed "Grace Halbin" in the lower right corner.
title: Penny Bank
